prompt: What year was Coca-Cola invented, who created it, and what were Coca-Cola Company's sales last year?

answers.message:
- **Year Coca‑Cola was invented:** **1886** (born May 8, 1886).  
- **Creator:** **Dr. John Stith Pemberton** (with **Frank M. Robinson** credited with penning the “Coca‑Cola” name/trademark; Coca‑Cola’s own history page credits Pemberton as the producer of the syrup and inventor context).  
- **Coca‑Cola Company sales last year:** In its “**full year 2024 results**” release, The Coca‑Cola Company reports **net revenues of $47.1 billion** for the year (i.e., **sales/“net revenues” for 2024**).  

**Sources:**  
- Coca‑Cola history (invented date, creator, and early sales): https://www.coca-colacompany.com/about-us/history/the-birth-of-a-refreshing-idea  
- Coca‑Cola net revenues for full year 2024: https://www.coca-colacompany.com/media-center/coca-cola-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2024-results
